meta.name: Vector layers (demo)
meta.description: Opens Mapbox Vector Tiles as a slide layer aligned to the slide's own pixel grid, for the visualization-flexibility showcase.
meta.longDescription: Registers the `demo-mvt` slide protocol. The descriptor states the slide's real width and height, so the vector layer aligns with the slide one-to-one, and declares which tiles exist in a sparse pyramid, so absent tiles are never requested. GeoJSON needs no such help and is opened by OpenSeadragon's ordinary autodetection.
